81819.subject: The AI Coin Nobody Understands
81819.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

With the Crypto x AI narrative running hot in recent weeks, a lot of the focus has been on three main tokens: VVV, GRASS and CHIP. These assets cover important areas of the AI trade, from private inference and pretraining data for LLMs to GPU financing.

But there is an AI token launched in 2017 that much of the market still does not fully understand. Part of the reason is that the team behind it operates a regulated hedge fund and is intentionally careful about what it shares publicly. Yet with firmwide AUM approaching $1B and the team now buying back the token, NMR deserves a closer look.

Numerai has curated clean and standardized stock and crypto market datasets that data scientists can use to train predictive models. These datasets contain over 1,000 different indicators and are built to the same standard as those used by quant firms to develop trading strategies.

Using AI, data scientists build models that aim to generate alpha uncorrelated to the market. Numerai then aggregates these predictions into a single Meta Model.

Numerai currently operates three funds using the same underlying alpha, with differences in leverage and structure to suit different investor preferences. Firmwide AUM now stands at around $770M, with backers including Paul Tudor Jones and JPMorgan.

Numerai had its only down year in 2023 before rebounding with its [strongest](https://blog.numer.ai/jpmorgan-secures-500m-capacity/) year on record in 2024, delivering a 25.45% net return. Numerai is not trying to outperform the S&P 500 by taking more market risk. Instead, it hedges out broad market exposure to isolate its own alpha. That performance and the uncorrelated nature of its strategy help explain why JPMorgan [committed](https://blog.numer.ai/jpmorgan-secures-500m-capacity/) up to $500M in capacity to Numerai in August 2025.

So how does the token fit into all of this, especially after Numerai [raised](https://www.tradingview.com/news/cointelegraph:4057f9a0f094b:0-ai-hedge-fund-numerai-wins-backing-from-top-university-endowments-token-soars/) $30M at a $500M valuation in November 2025?

Data scientists can submit models without staking, but only staked predictions are included in the Meta Model. Staking NMR also allows contributors to earn rewards based on the following [formula](https://docs.numer.ai/numerai-tournament/scoring/):

Reward or loss = NMR staked × clip(3 × CORR60 + 15 × MMC60, −1, +1)

CORR measures prediction accuracy against the target, while MMC measures the model’s contribution to Numerai’s combined Meta Model. The formula can also slash poorly performing models, serving as a supply sink while encouraging contributors to stake only on models they believe can continue generating alpha.
